summary: The failed test checks that a registered result has failed: True; skipped tasks and those not run due to syntax, templating or unreachable errors don't count as failed.
questions: How do I check if a registered task failed?
Is a skipped task considered failed?
Does an unreachable host show as failed in the test?

answer_card.title: failed test
answer_card.answer_md: `result is failed` is true when the result has `failed: true` (opposite of `succeeded`). Skipped tasks and those not executed due to syntax/templating/unreachable errors don't return failed.
